name: 3D Gaussian Splatting Self-Shadowing (T_light)
definition: Calculates the self-shadowing transmittance $T_{light}$ for each Gaussian along the sun direction. It represents the 'front occlusion transmittance' to model self-shadowing effects in volume rendering.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting Self-Shadowing calculates front occlusion transmittance via a dedicated light-space rasterization pass that accumulates depth-ordered occlusion without modifying the main camera's sampling expansion or applying amplitude compensation.
